title.zh: OpenAI 28天冲刺首日：GPT-6 Astra和6.1 Sol提速约50%
title.en: OpenAI 28天冲刺首日：GPT-6 Astra和6.1 Sol提速约50%

current_state.zh: OpenAI kicked off its 28-day product sprint with Day 1 delivering roughly 50% faster default generation for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, automatically rolled out to Codex, ChatGPT Work, and third-party tools authenticated via 'Sign in with ChatGPT'.
